tools.name: invoice_to_excel
tools.description: Read an invoice (PDF, scan or photo) and turn it into a spreadsheet: returns the header fields, the line items and download links to an Excel (.xlsx) and a CSV file, valid for 60 minutes without signing in. Give the file as file_url, file_base64 or (ChatGPT) file.

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.description: Check whether an invoice adds up: each line's quantity times unit price, the lines against the subtotal, the tax against its printed rate, and subtotal plus tax against the total. Returns a one-line verdict and every problem found, with the invoice's own numbers. Give the file as file_url, file_base

tools.name: extract_invoice_data
tools.description: Extract an invoice's data as structured JSON: vendor and customer, invoice number and dates, PO number, currency, subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total, tax lines, every line item, and confidence (overall and per field). Give the file as file_url, file_base64 or (ChatGPT) file.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of an invoice that was still being read when its tool call returned. Pass the job_id that call gave. Returns the spreadsheet links, the math check and the extracted data.
